reviews.title: Badly scratched our rims, driver lied, currently working with police
reviews.text:
A good concept for a service, unfortunately still a number of problems. One driver badly scratched our rims on a school run, the driver denied it despite my wife being in the car at the time.

Mistakes happen, it’s how the company is dealing with it now that is so poor. Emaar have the CCTV footage which is being handed to the police. Significant wasted time when they should have just done the right thing.

The other challenge is you get a different driver for each school run, so need to explain all the details each time, morning and afternoon then again.

We’ll be forfeiting our pre paid remaining 10 school run trips rather than using the service when I’m away from work again.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: I get the point that it’s difficult to get someone to be on time when you do a last minute booking. But 3 hours delay??? Even when I book 1 day in advance???

reviews.title: There is
reviews.text:
The app works, but designed in favor of service and driver. 

You are not able to control how much time driver spends during the trip during per-minute drives. 

In my case, daytime trip Dubai-Sharjah took 110 minutes, usually it takes 50-60 minutes. 

When I raised this with support team they responded with copy-paste response and relied on drivers words. 

I was lucky to have WhatsApp message from garage manager, accepting car to the service, which was dates 15 minutes before driver ended the trip. 

But this evidence was only sufficient for dispute of 15 minutes, however I think case when driver is not finishing per-minute trip intentionally should leave to in-depth investigation. 

The biggest frustration is support team using copy-paste messages without proper investigation.

reviews.title: App issues
reviews.text: I am using their services for the last three years. It is very difficult to reach customer support services and lots of issues in their app/portal. There is a strong need for improvement.

reviews.title: Slow
reviews.text: Service is good when it arrives but reliability for rebooking is poor

reviews.title: Support Needs Improvement
reviews.text: Unfortunately the support needs improvement. It’s difficult getting quick support when needed, even during normal hours outside of the busy hours. Additionally the driver could literally be 30 minutes away and they still show you a 5-10 minute pickup time which is not true. Needs improvement.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Drivers accepting rides and then asking you to cancel as they are too far away and then it charges you with AED 15 to cancel the ride. Very unprofessional and needs addressing.

reviews.title: Useless in Abu Dhabi
reviews.text: Tried this app in Abu Dhabi and only got drivers from Dubai accepting my request. They don’t seem to be able to recognise the pick up location properly. Totally waste of time.

reviews.title: Long delays and cancellations
reviews.text: We have used the app multiple times with mixed service. Unfortunately it seems drivers can cancel jobs even after they’ve been booked and accepted, which left us waiting 2 hours for a ride even after we had specifically pre booked to avoid such problems. The drivers are great once you get them but unfortunately the company seems more interested in profits than customer service. Very disappointed.
